description:

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive HR professional to manage end-to-end Human Resources operations for our organization. title: Workday HCM Technical Analyst
description:
Are you a Workday expert who enjoys solving complex business challenges, designing


innovative solutions, and making a real impact on the employee experience? We're


looking for a highly skilled **Workday HCM Technical Analyst** to serve as a key


technology partner to our Human Resources organization.  



In this role, you'll be the go\-to expert for Workday, driving the configuration,


optimization, integration, and continuous improvement of our HR technology ecosystem.


You'll work across multiple Workday modules, collaborate with business and technical


teams, and help transform HR processes through automation, analytics, and innovative


solutions. No two days are the same. One day you may be architecting a complex


integration, the next designing executive dashboards, implementing new functionality, or


solving business challenges through creative system configuration.  



This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining deep technical


expertise with strategic thinking. If you're passionate about Workday, thrive in a fast\-


paced environment, and enjoy partnering with stakeholders to deliver meaningful


business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.  



**What You'll Love About This Role:**

* Be a trusted Workday expert and technical advisor for HR.
* Influence the design and evolution of our HR technology landscape.
* Work with a broad range of Workday modules, integrations, security, reporting, and analytics.
* Interfaces and security will be your expertise area.
* Participate in challenging projects, enhancements, and new capabilities from concept through implementation.
* Partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Benefits, and vendors to deliver solutions that improve business processes and employee experience.
Continuously learn and stay up to date on the latest Workday functionality, implementation trends and best practices.  
* 

**Core Capabilities:**

* **System Configuration:** Experience deploying integrations for Workday HCM modules, including Core HCM, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, and Benefits, to align with business requirements.
* **Data Management:** Manage data integrity and accuracy within the Workday system, including data imports, exports, and reporting. Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with data standards.
* **Integration Expert:** Collaborate with IT and third\-party vendors to design, implement, and maintain integrations between Workday and other systems (e.g., payroll, time tracking, IAM, and benefits administration).
* **User Support:** Provide technical support and training to HR staff and end\-users, addressing system\-related inquiries and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
* **Reporting and Analytics Expert:** Develop and maintain custom reports and dashboards in Workday to provide insights into HR metrics and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* **Project Participation:** Participate in Workday upgrade projects, enhancements, and new module implementations, ensuring timely delivery and adherence to best practices.
* **Documentation:** Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, processes, and user guides to facilitate knowledge sharing and training.
* **Compliance and Security:** Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security policies, monitoring access and permissions within the Workday system.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Workday HCM Technical Analyst or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of Workday HCM modules, functionalities, interfaces, security, configurations and reporting.
* Proficiency in Workday reporting tools, including calculated fields, custom reports, and dashboards.
* Proficiency with Workday Integrations using XML, XSLT, SOAP, REST API, and Configurable Security/experience securing web services.
* Experience with Workday integrations (e.g., PICOF, PECI, WECI, EIB, Core Connectors, Workday Studio) is required.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong design and architecture skills to generate and maintain specification documents and integration documentation.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
Workday HCM and Workday Integration certifications is a plus.  
* 

**Who we are:**

Mold\-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co\-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold\-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.  



  

Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission\-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders.
  

  

EEO: The policy of Hillenbrand Inc. is to extend opportunities to qualified applicants and employees on an equal basis regardless of an individual's age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression or veteran status. Additionally, Hillenbrand Inc. and our operating companies are committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us at recruitingaccommodations@hillenbrand.com . In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying. At Hillenbrand, everyone is welcome to apply and "Shape What Matters for Tomorrow".

title: Lead Employee Experience
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  

At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses \- and their internal customers \- to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.


**The Role**  

Presidio looks for Senior EX Lead, you will be the primary point of contact for employee concerns — spanning recognition, mentorship and project transitions. You will also own Presidio's employee survey programs.



You operate as a trusted, confidential presence in the organization someone employees will bring a concern to before they bring it anywhere else, and someone the business trusts to represent the employee voice without turning every issue into an escalation. The role sits at the intersection of people, data, and business context: you'll spend as much time reading survey data and spotting patterns as you will sitting across from someone working through a difficult situation.


**People**


* You will listen to employees directly, or through our Practice EX Specialists, to understand their concerns.
* You will raise issues with the business unit head, HR Business Partner, or Leadership teams, and follow through until they're resolved.
* You will manage our anonymous reporting channels and triage submissions, and support new joiners through their first 90 days.
* You will run and coordinate mentorship programs — matching mentors and mentees, equipping managers to mentor effectively, and tracking whether mentoring relationships are actually landing.
* You will mediate conflicts between employees, peers, and managers — getting all sides heard, working through disagreements to a fair resolution, and knowing when to involve the business unit head or Leadership.
* You will work closely with the business stakeholders on various programs like immersion, Next Gen leadership, and Leadership connect.


**Surveys**


* You will design and run milestone surveys — onboarding (1\-month, 3\-month), half\-yearly pulse, promotion, project change, high\-potential (HiPo), and exit surveys.
* You will analyse results, spot trends, and share findings — monthly with internal stakeholders, quarterly with Leadership and the Talent Development team.


**Stakeholder Management \& Reporting**


* You will build working relationships with business unit heads and Practice Leads so that employee issues get resolved through influence, not escalation — people bring you concerns because they trust you'll handle them well.
* You will keep Leadership informed of emerging themes before they become patterns — flagging risk early rather than reporting it after attrition or disengagement has already set in.
* You will maintain a living view of employee sentiment across practices and locations, and use it to recommend concrete changes \- not just report numbers.


**What Success Looks Like**


* **First 90 days:** You've met the practice leads, business unit heads, and Practice EX Specialists you'll work with, and run your first onboarding and pulse surveys on schedule.
* **First 6 months:** Your mentorship program has active mentor\-mentee pairs, and Leadership is receiving your quarterly findings and acting on your recommendations.
* **First year:** You're recognized as the person who resolves employee concerns fairly, and survey data shows measurable improvement in an area you've focused on.


**Required**


* A bachelor's degree in any discipline IT with Psychology from MSSW background would be an added advantage
* 6–8 years of combined experience in Talent Development or people\-facing roles within IT/technical environments.
* A track record of resolving employee issues and mediating conflict by working through business stakeholders, without relying on formal authority.
* Experience designing surveys and analysing data.
* Experience running or coordinating mentorship programs.
* Comfortable operating without formal positional authority, influencing outcomes through relationships, credibility, and follow\-through rather than policy enforcement.


**Skills**


* You build trust easily and handle sensitive information with discretion.
* You're organised and data\-literate, comfortable building a survey, tracking responses, and turning data into a clear report.
* You stay calm under conflict, help people move past disagreement, and coach managers on handling difficult conversations.
* You follow through. Employees remember who circled back and who didn't you close every loop you open.


**Growth \& Life at Presidio**


* You'll build a track record owning a visible, high\-trust function close to Leadership — strong preparation for broader Talent Development or People leadership roles, with deep cross\-functional exposure to Practice Leads and India Leadership.


**Your future at Presidio**  

JoiningPresidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers \- thinkers, builders, and collaborators \- who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.



Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.


**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next\-together.**


**About** **Presidio**  

Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.



At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio's expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, and enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally. For more information visit

  




*Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.*


*Presidio has a strong commitment to the community we serve and our employees. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to have a workforce that includes the community we serve.*


***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:*** Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our career's email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any feeds related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

title: CRT Executive
description:
A **CRT (Candidate Relations Team / Case Resolution Team) Domestic BGV (Background Verification) The operations** specialist manages the **end\-to\-end domestic screening processes** for candidates within a specific country. The core purpose of this role is to **validate candidate credentials**, coordinate directly with applicants to resolve data discrepancies, and manage third\-party vendors to ensure compliance with hiring standards. They act as the primary operational link between the candidate, verification authorities, and the internal HR or client recruitment teams.

Job Summary:

The Domestic BGV Operations Associate/Specialist is responsible for executing and tracking background screening workflows, including identity checks, academic verifications, employment history reviews, and criminal record searches. The "CRT" designation emphasizes a heavy focus on candidate\-facing resolution—interacting with applicants to clear flagged red/amber issues, collect missing documentation, and smooth out the onboarding journey. \[1, 2, 3]Key Responsibilities

* **Case Initiation \& Workflow Management:** Initiate domestic background checks including PAN/Aadhaar/identity authentication, address verification, and professional references.
* **Candidate Relations \& Discrepancy Resolution:** Function as the dedicated point of contact for candidates during the verification lifecycle. Proactively engage with individuals to resolve "insufficient information" flags or minor data mismatches (e.g., notice period or company merger variations).
* **Vendor \& Field Executive Coordination:** Coordinate with internal field teams or third\-party BGV vendors to track Turnaround Time (TAT) and enforce Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* **Report Analysis \& Adjudication:** Evaluate completed screening reports against company risk matrices. Escalate critical discrepancies, fake documentation, or amber/red cases to management or HR Business Partners.
* **Compliance \& Data Security:** Ensure all screening and digital consent steps conform to strict national regulations like India's DPDP Act compliance standards

Pay: ₹10,013\.78 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: People Operations - Sr. Advisor
description:
Job Description


About Maersk


Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.


At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organization reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.


With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.


Join us as we harness cutting\-edge technologies and unlock opportunities on a global scale. Together, let's sail towards a brighter, more sustainable future with Maersk.


What we Offer


This is an exciting career opportunity in an international, challenging business setting known for diversity and high paced environment. You will get to focus on creating valuable relations with stakeholders and work with highly professional teams in an environment where you will be valued, recognized and well rewarded.


You will work with amazing and diverse colleagues with a deep sense of commitment to live Our Values and together, go all the way for our customers, society and for each other.


Job Description:


As a People Operations Sr. Advisor ,You will be part of the team that is the first point of contact for employees and leaders, helping them solve HR queries online, on the phone or on site. Whether their issue is big or small, our people should feel cared for just the same and your role is making sure they have a great experience when they reach out to HR.


You will join the People Operations Advisory team with the new HR service delivery model, processes and technology. Your role as a People Operations Advisor will be to solve the HR\-related queries of our employees and managers and make sure their interaction with HR results in a great experience.


Own to resolution people’s inquiries about HR policies and procedures, like compensation, benefits, performance management, leave, payroll and HR applications, and other matters related to the employee lifecycle.


* Respond to our employees and managers through a variety of channels (HR case management, phone, email, live chat)
* Guide employees and managers in using self\-service in Workday and other HR systems, to facilitate technology adoption
* Promote the usage of the employee HR Portal by providing guidance on HR knowledge content, such as global \& local HR policies, How\-To, etc.
* Manage HR data quality and perform transactions in Workday and other HR applications
* Work together with People Partners and functional specialists to solve complex queries
* Prepare and handle HR documentation
* Coordinate and administer onboarding and offboarding processes
* Support improvement activities to simplify and standardize the HR processes
* Deliver on high employee satisfaction, accuracy, and timeliness.

As an SME you will furthermore support the delivery of the HR Cycle with administrative tasks related to onboarding, Employee life cycle, job moves, exit, etc.


* Knowledge of local labor law would be beneficial
* Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday, workday case management \& Process Optimization.
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills, ability to manage conflict, and attention to detail
* Drive to identify needs, investigate options, seek solutions and partner with other HR colleagues to resolve issues
* Ability to take initiative, manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to be an engaged member of a virtual team
* Closure orientation and low tolerance for delays and deviations
* A degree in Human Resources or similar and knowledge of HR concepts are a strong plus.
* Flexible to work varied hours based on business needs.

Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.


6\+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, People Operations, or a customer support environment.


Experience working with HR systems, preferably Workday and HR case management platforms.


Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain HR policies and processes clearly.


Demonstrated problem\-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.


Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, service\-oriented environment.


Preferred Qualifications


Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, HR operations, and shared services environments.


Understanding of local labor laws and HR compliance requirements.


Experience supporting global or regional employee populations.


Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies and process standardization initiatives

The My HR Live Support (MHLS) team is currently seeking to hire an MHLS Sr. Advisor to support our Tier 2 Specialty Operation. title: Sailpoint
description:
**Role description**  


Role Summary


The SailPoint IAM Platform Engineer will design, integrate, administer, secure, and support the SailPoint identity platform and its connected enterprise applications. The role combines application onboarding, identity lifecycle automation, Linux and application\-server administration, vulnerability mitigation, high availability, disaster recovery, and audit support. The engineer will help ensure reliable provisioning and deprovisioning, least\-privilege access, secure connectivity, and timely access revocation for employees, contractors, and third\-party users.


Key Responsibilities


1\. SailPoint Integration \& Application Onboarding


* Lead end\-to\-end onboarding and integration of enterprise applications into SailPoint IAM.
* Configure and support identity aggregation, account correlation, access profiles, entitlements, provisioning, deprovisioning, and reconciliation.
* Partner with application owners, HR, infrastructure, security, and audit teams to capture requirements, define controls, test integrations, and transition solutions into production.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, integration specifications, support procedures, and operational runbooks.
2\. Enterprise Systems in Scope


* WMS and workforce or warehouse management systems.
* SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA.
* Master Data Management platforms.
* Active Directory and LDAP directories.
* Electronic signature platforms, including DocuSign and Adobe Acrobat Sign.
* HR platforms and other authoritative sources that trigger identity lifecycle events.
3\. Identity Lifecycle \& Process Enhancement


* Design, enhance, and streamline identity lifecycle processes for joiners, movers, leavers, contractors, and third\-party users.
* Integrate SailPoint with HR systems and authoritative sources to trigger lifecycle events accurately and consistently.
* Automate access provisioning and deprovisioning in line with least\-privilege principles and approved access policies.
* Ensure timely revocation of access for leavers, terminated personnel, and expired contractors.
* Continuously fine\-tune workflows, rules, approvals, exception handling, and operational controls to improve reliability and reduce manual effort.
4\. Linux \& SailPoint Platform Administration


* Administer Linux environments, with strong hands\-on expertise in Oracle Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
* Manage SailPoint application servers and Tomcat, including JVM tuning, service configuration, performance optimization, and log management.
* Perform operating\-system\-level troubleshooting, capacity monitoring, root\-cause analysis, and performance tuning.
* Administer file systems, permissions, scheduled jobs and cron jobs, system services, and platform certificates.
* Maintain secure communication between SailPoint and connected target systems.
5\. Vulnerability Mitigation, Security \& Compliance


* Review and remediate vulnerabilities identified through OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* Plan and apply SailPoint patches, hotfixes, and third\-party library upgrades using controlled change and validation procedures.
* Perform operating\-system hardening aligned with applicable CIS Benchmarks and organizational security standards.
* Manage TLS/SSL certificates, keystores, truststores, renewals, and certificate\-related incident resolution.
* Support ISO, SOC, internal security, and customer audit reviews by providing evidence, remediation updates, and control documentation.
* Follow security, change, incident, problem, and release management practices.
6\. High Availability, Resilience \& Disaster Recovery


* Configure, operate, and support SailPoint high\-availability architecture hosted in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
* Manage clustering, load balancing, node health, failover behavior, and availability monitoring.
* Coordinate disaster recovery activities, recovery validation, and periodic failover testing.
* Monitor platform health, availability, performance, interfaces, queues, logs, and scheduled jobs; take proactive corrective action.
* Participate in production support, major incident resolution, and after\-hours support as required by the operating model.
Required Skills \& Experience


* Strong hands\-on experience with SailPoint application integration, connector configuration, application onboarding, and identity lifecycle management.
* Demonstrated experience administering enterprise SailPoint environments and supporting production operations.
* Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting experience, particularly Oracle Linux and RHEL.
* Hands\-on experience with Tomcat administration, JVM tuning, log analysis, certificate management, file systems, and cron scheduling.
* Experience remediating infrastructure and application vulnerabilities using OCI Security Scanning, Tenable, Qualys, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with HA, clustering, load balancing, failover, disaster recovery, and health monitoring in OCI or a comparable cloud environment.
* Working knowledge of IAM principles, least privilege, access governance, segregation of duties, provisioning, deprovisioning, and audit controls.
* Integration experience with HR systems, Active Directory/LDAP, SAP, MDM, WMS, and SaaS applications through standard connectors, APIs, or secure file interfaces.
* Strong analytical, documentation, stakeholder\-management, and production\-support skills.
Education \& Certification


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud Professional credential or SailPoint Certified Identity Security Engineer certification is required or strongly preferred, based on the final hiring level.
* Additional Linux, cloud, security, ITIL, or IAM certifications are advantageous.
Preferred Technical Exposure


* SailPoint Identity Security Cloud and/or IdentityIQ.
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Linux shell scripting, REST APIs, web services, JDBC, SCIM, and directory integrations.
* Monitoring, ticketing, source control, CI/CD, and enterprise change\-management tools.
* Security baselines, vulnerability management, certificate lifecycle management, and compliance evidence preparation.
Key Competencies


* Ownership and accountability for platform reliability and secure operations.
* Structured troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Risk awareness and disciplined change execution.
* Collaboration across HR, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, and audit teams.
* Clear communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on automation and operational resilience.

title: Workday HCM/Security and Recruiting Senior Analyst
description:
**Position Summary**

The Workday HCM, Recruiting \& Security Analyst is responsible for functional leadership, solution design, administration, optimization, and ongoing ownership of Workday HCM, Recruiting, and Security as a key member of the Global HR Shared Services team.


This role acts as a Workday strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Shared Services, business stakeholders, HR Product Owners, IT, and downstream technology teams. The role will translate business requirements into scalable Workday solutions, leveraging configuration, process design, and practical workarounds to address complex business needs.


The successful candidate will bring prior Workday implementation and /o r consulting experience, with the ability to connect the dots across the technology ecosystem, understand downstream impacts, and design solutions that balance business needs, system capabilities, user experience, and long\-term sustainability.


This position will lead and contribute to Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, releases, and special projects.


Reporting to the HR Shared Services Leader, this role combines Workday sec urity expertise , funct ional knowle dge, solution architecture, business partnership, implementation experience, and leadership thinking to continuously improve the HR technology landscape.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Workday HCM**

* Own the functional design and optimization of Workday HCM business processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into scalable Workday solutions.
* Evaluate Workday functionality and develop configuration\-based solutions and practical workarounds where standard functionality does not fully meet business needs.
* Connect requirements across Workday modules and consider upstream and downstream impacts when designing solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR Product Owners and business stakeholders on Workday capabilities, limitations, and solution options.
**Workday Security**

* Serve as a functional SME for Workday Security, ensuring solutions align with business requirements, organizational structures, and governance standards.
* Design and implement Workday security solutions in conjunction with HCM and other module business processes, with strong knowledge of Workday security group types, including Intersection, Aggregation, and Mixed security groups, and their application in designing complex access requirements.
* Assess the impact of organizational and business process changes on security and recommend appropriate solutions .
* Apply a solution architect mindset across functional areas , considering the broader Workday ecosystem rather than individual modules in isolation.
* Identify dependencies and downstream impacts and proactively engage the appropriate stakeholders .
**Special Projects \& Business Transformation**

* Lead and participate in Workday enhancements, implementations, organizational changes, and strategic HR technology initiatives across the solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Assess the impact of organizational changes and business priorities across modules. Lead UAT, regression, release testing, and implementation activities.
* HCM and Security, Recruiting and exposure to Compensation is considered a strong advantage
* Evaluate solution options and drive delivery by balancing business needs, user experience, scalability, and sustainability while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience working with Workday HCM and Security preferably in a Workday implementation or consulting environment .
* Workday certifications in HCM is a must and any Advanced Modules is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with Workday implementations, enhancements, configuration projects, or complex solution design.
* Experience translating business requirements into Workday functional solutions and developing configuration\-based workarounds.
* Experience with Workday Recruiting configuration, business processes, supporting Business as Usual, releases, and deployment activities.
* Strong understanding of cross\-functional dependencies between Workday modules and downstream technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to independently assess complex requirements and recommend solutions.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt solutions to changing business needs.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence global stakeholders.
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Workday Compensation and related business processes .
* Experience designing solutions across multiple Workday modules.
* Experience supporting organizational restructuring, business transformation, or significant changes in business processes.

title: Functional Consultant-D365 HR
description:
Are you a passionate and enthusiastic Dynamics 365 HR professional looking to build your career in HR digital transformation and enterprise application consulting?


Join LevelShift as a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR**, where you'll help organizations streamline and transform their HR processes by implementing and optimizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources. You'll collaborate with HR stakeholders, business users, technical teams, and solution architects to understand existing HR processes, perform fit\-gap analysis, and deliver scalable HR solutions.

  

  

**What You'll Do**


As a **Functional Consultant Dynamics 365 HR** at LevelShift, you will:


* Engage with HR stakeholders and business users to understand existing HR processes, business requirements, and system challenges.
* Conduct requirement gathering, process analysis, and fit\-gap analysis to identify the best Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Analyze existing Workday or other HR systems and map their functionality and processes to Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Configure and implement Dynamics 365 HR functionalities based on business requirements and functional design.
* Prepare business requirement documents, functional design documents, process flows, user stories, and other functional documentation.
* Support HR system migration, including data mapping, data migration, validation, and reconciliation.
* Collaborate with technical teams on integrations and the transition of functionality from legacy or third\-party HR applications.
* Work closely with HR stakeholders, business users, architects, and project teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Support SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, end\-user training, deployment, and post\-implementation activities.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate existing HR applications, optimize business processes, and introduce automation using Dynamics 365 HR.
  

  

**How This Role Uses AI**


* Should be comfortable using AI tools to enhance consulting workflows, automate repetitive tasks, generate business insights, and improve productivity while ensuring solution quality and governance.
* Utilize AI\-assisted requirement analysis, process documentation, process mapping, testing, and workflow automation to improve project delivery efficiency.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Dynamics 365 Copilot, Power Platform Copilot, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Fabric AI capabilities to support documentation, analysis, automation, testing, and HR process optimization.
* Explore opportunities to use AI capabilities to improve HR operations, automate routine processes, and provide actionable business insights.
  

  

**Your Skillset**


* 5\+ years of experience in functional consulting and solution delivery, with strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources.
* Strong hands\-on experience in configuring and implementing Dynamics 365 Human Resources functionalities based on business requirements.
* Strong understanding of core HR processes and employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in requirement gathering, business process analysis, fit\-gap analysis, and functional solution design.
* Ability to work directly with HR and business stakeholders to understand requirements and recommend appropriate Dynamics 365 HR solutions.
* Experience in preparing functional documentation, including BRD, FDD, process flows, user stories, and functional specifications.
* Hands\-on experience with HR system migration, data mapping, data validation, and transitioning functionality from legacy or third\-party applications.
* Understanding of system integrations and collaboration with technical teams to support HR application integrations.
* Experience in SIT, UAT, testing, defect management, user training, and deployment activities.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with distributed teams, and drive activities from requirements through implementation.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying current with Dynamics 365, Power Platform, AI, and Microsoft ecosystem innovations.
  

  

**Why LevelShift?**


* Accelerate your career growth by working on impactful HR digital transformation and enterprise application initiatives.
* Gain hands\-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Human Resources, Power Platform, AI, and modern business application technologies.
* Learn from experienced consultants, architects, and technology leaders in a collaborative environment.
* Work alongside cross\-functional teams that value innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Solve real\-world HR and business challenges by delivering scalable solutions that improve processes and operational efficiency.
* Access continuous learning opportunities, certification support, professional development programs, and exposure to emerging AI\-powered business applications.
